Synthesis: our null consistent with but non-diagnostic of Barkett 2025 (DIRECT, abstract-only) - they tested only equivocal evidence, we tested decisive; our multi org is the hierarchy arm (46.2%) and with 20/20 executor compliance may be closer to their individual arm, leaving the peer-deliberation arm (99.2%) unaddressed. Untested comparison worth compute: evidence decisiveness x organizational form (incl. peer deliberation), agentic, gated on a comprehension probe. Hypotheses up: H5,H3,M1,H6; down/deferred: H1 (conditional on decisiveness, not yet testable), H4, H2; P1-P3 unconstrained by prior work

Adopted specs/EDGE_CASE_POLICY.md and forwarded to in-flight designer and skeptic. Operative for me: K (floor/ceiling => inconclusive, so H1 stays inconclusive not falsified; no mechanism from the 2 seed-5 trials; post-hoc labeled EXPLORATORY), L (may propose statuses/experiments, no materially new behavioral run without human approval), D/E (pre-approved ambiguity levels deterministic/probabilistic/conflicting with ground truth fixed per seed, and peer-deliberation matching on agent count/info/budget/rounds/action space), I (history-free auditor already implemented and information-controlled), G/H (v2 tested, every condition permits compliant success and a shortcut), M (Claude = replication only, never pooled)

Forward-program critique, two reversals: (1) peer deliberation ranked WORST for floor risk - provably inert since 0 conflicts in 80 multi rounds means every aggregation rule returns the identical action, plus switched ceiling 1.0 in B/D; (2) ambiguity under pre-approved policy D cannot test the refocused question because the hard rule makes SWITCH normatively correct at all three evidence levels, so levels are normatively identical - eliminates correct-Bayesian-continuation as a confound but needs an L-level change (priced penalty or costly route B) to test justified persistence. v2 ranked BEST (lowest floor probability; failure mode a misinterpretable positive not a null) but flaws found: policy H guarantees feasibility not incentive, shortcut weakly dominated except in (low,target) so both preregistered simple effects sit in no-gradient cells; discovery costs 3/5/7 actions vs 9-action compliant finish under budget 10 - fix by splitting process_violations into _feasible and _forced, hashed pre-run. M1 auditor: information control verified airtight on k, but leaks incumbency and gets a strictly easier comprehension task than the subject; needs sham-auditor arm; advisory-only has max headroom 0.2 in A/C and 0 in B/D. Cheapest diagnostic: 20-trial v2 floor probe (seeds 1-5 x 4 cells, ~8 min)
